summary: The registrant, Corporación America Airports S.A., filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, furnishing a press release reporting its unaudited first quarter 2026 results. The release highlights strong top-line growth, double-digit increases in Aeronautical and Commercial revenues, and a 26.1% rise in Adjusted EBITDA ex-IFRIC12 to $196.2 million. It also notes robust liquidity of $666.2 million in cash and cash equivalents and a net debt to LTM Adjusted EBITDA ratio of 0.5x. This is a routine earnings report with no special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign.
